skills: Up to 4 Wind hits. The 4th hit builds 20 Flowing Breath and dodges as it starts: dodging an attack with it raises it to Fierce Whirl's multipliers and adds 15 Flowing Breath. Invulnerable on the 4th hit. Dash Attack, Dodge Counter and Freehand don't break the combo.

Triggers by itself when he's hit as one of the first three Basic hits starts, or when Glint Shadow dodges a hit for him: a dash dealing massive Wind DMG. Builds 15 Flowing Breath, +20 on hit. Hold to go straight into Azure Wind Shadow Hunt, whose final hit adds 20 more. Invulnerable.

Spends 100 Flowing Breath (hold Basic): a backstep, then nonstop weaving slashes for massive Wind DMG. The backstep counts as a dodge: dodging a hit triggers Vital View and +15 Flowing Breath. Invulnerable.
Quick dash dodge. A Perfect Dodge with it gives 15 Flowing Breath (once per 0.5s). Invulnerable.
After a Perfect Dodge with Drift Break: a quick Wind slash. Triggers by itself if you swap him out at that moment. Invulnerable.
Keep holding after a back dash to taunt the enemy.
Dashes in with claw strikes and slashes for Wind DMG. Invulnerable.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze. Invulnerable.
A slash, a claw strike and a cannon blast for Wind DMG. Invulnerable.
With Windrider, in combat, switch him in to unleash a powerful Wind slash. Counts as a Quick Assist, not a heavy attack. Invulnerable.
Slashes and thrusts forward for Wind DMG.

Costs Energy: a slash, claw and cannon combo for massive Wind DMG, gaining 1 Flickershade. Hold before the cannon to keep spending Energy on Wind Blades; spending the maximum gives 1 extra Shimmering Shadow. Invulnerable.
Rapid attacks for massive Wind DMG, then +35 Flowing Breath. Invulnerable.
Several rapid slashes for massive Wind DMG, then +100 Flowing Breath. Invulnerable.

core.name: Wind Without End
core.text:
CRIT DMG +60% and DMG +20%, plus another +30% DMG with another Wind Agent in the squad.
Using Swift Edge just as he's about to be hit dodges the attack: during the first three hits it unleashes Fierce Whirl; on the 4th it raises that hit to Fierce Whirl's multipliers.
Entering the field gives 2 Flickershade (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).
With Glint Shadow (max 2) and not invulnerable, a non-Control hit he fails to dodge or parry uses 1 stack to dodge it automatically and unleash Fierce Whirl. Gaining Glint Shadow at max gives 1 Windrider and upgrades his next Swift Edge to Fierce Whirl.
These dodges all count as Perfect Dodges. Each Perfect Dodge gives 1 Windborne, which lets him switch in with his Entry Skill.
Hitting with set skills or Perfect Dodging builds Flowing Breath (max 150); at 100, hold to spend it on Azure Wind Shadow Hunt.
Core Skill Base → F (total by F): CRIT DMG +28.8% and Base ATK +75.

ability.name: Optimal Deployment
ability.text: Each 1% CRIT Rate gives +8.5 ATK, up to 100% CRIT Rate.

mindscapes: Chain Attack gives 50 Flowing Breath. Entering with the Entry Skill uses a Chain Attack instead (still a non-heavy entry; once per 60s). Each Azure Wind Shadow Hunt gives 1 Windborne. His hits ignore 15% Wind RES.
Entering the field restores 150 Flowing Breath (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Perfect Dodges and Azure Wind Shadow Hunt give +20% PEN Ratio for 25s.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Entering combat or switching in: +10% ATK for 30s. Fierce Whirl and Azure Wind Shadow Hunt: +10% Decibel generation for 15s.
Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack and Chain Attack Lv. +2.
Flowing Breath cap 180, and entering the field restores 180. Azure Wind Shadow Hunt's final hit gets a fixed +350% multiplier and grants Rising Wind: +5 Flowing Breath per second for 5s.
